name: Legendary Shadow Master
body:
Your ability to defend yourself and make deadly attacks while in the shadows is legendary.

Prerequisite(s): 10th-level Shadowdancer

Benefit: The benefits granted by your shadow master ability improve to the following while you are in an area of dim light: DR 15/-; a +4 luck bonus on all saving throws; and your target is blinded for 2d6 rounds whenever you score a critical hit against a target located in an area of dim light. In addition, your caster level for all shadow spells and any spell or effect which creates or manipulate areas of darkness increases by 2.
